display_name: Book R-252 · USD ETF Momentum Control
status: research-only causal retrospective audit; not live, funded, or a true blind backtest

method.decision: At each month-end close, rank a fixed ETF universe by positive 252-session momentum adjusted for 63-session log-return volatility.
method.portfolio: Up to three equal-weight long ETFs, with one ETF per predeclared economic cluster and 95% gross exposure.
method.execution: Fill at the next common market open. No shorting, leverage, intrabar stops, or targets. Final liquidation cost included.

required_next_evidence: A genuinely unseen third-party historical lockbox or a meaningful forward-paper period after the 2026-08-28 specification freeze.
Reconciled account-currency valuation before comparing it with GBP books.
Dividend / total-return data for benchmark-quality ETF comparisons.
